tickets.title: Coordinate Retirement Plan Rollover
tickets.text: Prepare a pre-clearance narrative covering the proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and confirmation of no material nonpublic information for Selene Velvetreed's Tin Sparrow Robotics holdings to be reviewed by Apricot Compass Advisory.

subTasks.title: Gather plan and account details
subTasks.text: Request current plan statement, investment menu, fee disclosures, distribution paperwork, and any employer separation or plan eligibility details from Selene Velvetreed regarding her Tin Sparrow Robotics holdings.

subTasks.title: Analyze rollover alternatives
subTasks.text: Compare keeping assets in the current plan, rolling to a new employer plan, rolling to an IRA, or taking other permissible action for Selene Velvetreed's Tin Sparrow Robotics shares, including fees, services, creditor protection considerations, investment access, and tax implications.

subTasks.title: Prepare recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Draft a concise summary of the recommended path, required client decisions, anticipated transfer method, and any cautions for advisor review regarding Selene Velvetreed's proposed sale of Tin Sparrow Robotics shares.

subTasks.title: Track transfer and confirm investment plan
subTasks.text: After client authorization, monitor rollover status, confirm receipt of funds, and coordinate reinvestment according to the approved allocation for Selene Velvetreed's Tin Sparrow Robotics proceeds.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to prepare pre-clearance narrative covering proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and no material nonpublic information to Apricot Compass Advisory.

tickets.title: Collect Tax Documents
tickets.text: Collect the before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios for Selene Velvetreed's 4,000 vested nonqualified stock options (exercise price $12.40) to be provided to Apricot Compass Advisory by 2024-09-11.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-11 to provide before-tax exercise cost, estimated withholding, and cash-needed scenarios because vested options expire soon after the next blackout window.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody Share Feed
tickets.text: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody's 18,200-share feed with the 19,050 vested shares reported in the Tin Sparrow Robotics employer report for Selene Velvetreed by 2024-09-10.
